HomePage.title: Artisan Honey
HomePage.description: Discover our premium selection of pure, artisan honey — raw, unfiltered, and independently verified. Straight from Cairo, Egypt.
HomePage.featuredDesc: Each jar is a single-origin harvest — nothing added, nothing taken away.
HomePage.qualityDesc: We send every harvest to an accredited lab and publish the results. No fillers, no glucose syrup, no shortcuts — just proof you can read for yourself.
HomePage.why1Desc: Cold-extracted to keep enzymes, pollen and aroma intact.
HomePage.why2Desc: Traceable to a single harvest — never blended or diluted.
HomePage.why3Desc: Shipped across Egypt with care, straight to your door.
HomePage.ctaBannerTitle: Taste the difference real honey makes
HomePage.ctaBannerDesc: Order today and taste honey the way nature intended.
